description: Modified EUI-64 from RFC 4291. A 48-bit MAC is expanded by flipping the U/L bit and inserting FF-FE in the middle. A 64-bit value with FF-FE in the middle is folded back to the MAC. Any other 64-bit value is returned as-is with mac null. The bits, local and multicast fields describe the 64-bit result. Flipping the bit makes a universal MAC look local in the interface id. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/eui64
